versions.changelog:
ai-self-evolution v1.0.1

- No file changes detected in this version; documentation and logic remain unchanged.
- No user-facing or internal feature adjustments in this release.
- Behavior, workflows, and formats remain consistent with previous version.

Initial release of ai-self-evolution skill for continuous improvement through structured experience recording.

- Tracks errors, user corrections, feature requests, API/tool failures, knowledge gaps, best practices, and repeated patterns.
- Implements pre-task (session start) auto-review and post-task (session end) experience summarization and logging.
- Defines clear formats and status lifecycles for Learnings, Errors, and Feature Requests in project or workspace `.learnings/` directory.
- Supports automatic merging, archiving, and prioritization of high-value learnings and recurring issues.
- Enables promotion of transferable knowledge to project memory files such as CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, SOUL.md, and TOOLS.md.
